name: Death Elemental
primary:
A death elemental appears in front of you and follows you for 60 s. At most 2 elementals serve you at once: a third one replaces the oldest. It attacks monsters nearby and whoever fights you, and never harms you or your allies.
A hooded wraith that floats next to you and drains life every 1.3 s from up to 13 blocks. The drain never misses and heals the wraith by 1 ❤:
• Damage 1.5 ❤ death
• Life drain: 1 ❤ damage, you heal 0.5 ❤
• Withering for 3 s
self_description: The elemental appears right next to you.
